clinical_context.history_presenting_illness: Household collects drinking water from an open river and has experienced recent diarrheal episodes. They have acquired WaterGuard (1.2% sodium hypochlorite).
observations: Observed during encounter: Point-of-Use Drinking Water Disinfection
clinical_context.adversarial_distractor: Do not drink treated water immediately before 30-minute contact time

required_clinical_actions: Add 1 capful of WaterGuard per 20 liters of clear water (or 2 capfuls for turbid water)
Shake/stir well and wait at least 30 minutes before drinking
Store water in a clean, covered container with a narrow mouth or tap
Do not use dirty cups to scoop water
strictly_forbidden_actions: Do not drink treated water immediately before 30-minute contact time
Do not add chemical disinfectant directly to unfiltered muddy sludge
gold_standard_assessment.clinical_rationale: Validated against Kenya Ministry of Health eCHIS National Guidelines (2024 edition).

validation_metadata.certified_by: Dr. Sarah Kimani, MoH EmONC / Child Health Specialist
validation_metadata.organization: Kenya Ministry of Health Level 1 Quality Assurance
validation_metadata.comments: Certified gold standard benchmark scenario for edge SLM evaluation.
